command: Investigate the current rules.md and create an independent source-driven Node workflow collector, then a complete source-cited Skill in this SAME run. Scope is the explicitly labelled audited acceptance model, never the original synes business. Core/SDK must not change. Call code-map {}, export-snapshot include [rules.md], read-source, import-conventions notes/sourceIds. Use at most five schema lookups to get output, case and relation kind=transitions_to. Use includeIdentityHelper=true, list identity.mjs in artifacts; the helper exports computeEntityId(projectId,kind,orderedSlots), computeRelationId(projectId,kind,from,to,qualifiers), computeEvidenceId(sourceId,hash,start,end,role). orderedSlots are {name,value} objects, never a dictionary. workflowState slots scopeId,workflowId,semanticKey; documentType slots scopeId,semanticKey. Scope comes from configSubset, project ID also; choose one stable workflowId for this document. Implement a SMALL text grammar for documented lines STATE -> STATE: trigger, guard. Recompute states, edges and exact trigger/guard text from EACH current source; also parse the documented Documents chain and its ordered key names, emitting documentType entities and relates_document edges with qualifiers.orderedKeys as those names. Preserve the source words rather than interpreting code. Use declared/static assertions with actual UTF-8 evidence. Do not turn the conflict variant sentence, logging order or /help into transitions. This collector need not parse TS/SQL or invent router or column bindings. Handle empty input/deleted source as successful empty replacement; never hard-code states/paths/conditions as output. Coverage capability workflow, sourceSetId from the input sourceSets, complete for the supported current declarations; sources missing should yield empty output. One extract stage with rules.md selector and at least one meaningful case requiring real computed entity IDs and a real relation ID. Core schema=identity kind=workflowState slots={scopeId,workflowId,semanticKey} computes entity IDs. Core schema=identity kind=transitions_to fromId=... toId=... qualifiers={trigger,guard} computes the relation ID for the SAME qualifier values your script emits. For transitions_to ONLY use qualifiers trigger and guard, NOT orderedKeys or workflowId. orderedKeys belongs only to relates_document in this sample. Case input is the exact exported CollectorInput with pluginId/version/stageId adjusted to the manifest. Write manifest, collector, case and input in a bundle, validate-plugin, repair only structured errors within budget. After activation CONTINUE export-topic-context topicId=purchase-workflow query=purchase view=workflow maxChars=80000. Import a concise TopicArtifact preserving the returned metadata and ALL gaps. Each explanatory line has [[claim:id]], original evidenceIds from context.sourceReferences. Use basis=declared,origin=static for original document claims; no AI-inferred claims without required gaps. Then export-skill name=purchase-workflow. Do not stop at activation; finish only with a fresh complete Skill. IMPORTANT implementation constraints: keep the collector below 120 lines. Do not implement glob matching, framework logic, generic config validation or extra capabilities. Sources are ALREADY selected by the host. Output dependencies:[]; the Core records and validates host source/sourceSet dependencies itself. Do not guess source-set dependency hashes/keys from selector IDs. If you do emit dependencies, they must exactly match the exported key and digest, so prefer the empty list. Use a regex with exactly THREE capture groups for transition lines: from, to, and rest; the rest is match[3], not match[4]. Split rest at its FIRST comma into trigger and guard. Do not reword conditions. Parse the Documents chain and ordered key tokens directly from that current line. No Core/SDK template collectors or output facts may be copied; generate the small document parser yourself from this project's current source. No identityDelta is needed in this fixture; do not call update-base after plain notes import. Every entity AND relation assertion must reference an evidence object included in output.evidence. The small original document permits one actual whole-file evidence: startByte=0,endByte=Buffer.byteLength(content),startLine=1,endLine based on the last nonempty byte. Avoid exploratory loops. Once source, conventions and schemas are read, write the candidate, validate and proceed to knowledge.

Continue ONLY knowledge for the already activated plugin. The purchase workflow query selected documents but no state roots, so its context accurately contains partial gaps. Export a NEW current context for the SAME topicId purchase-workflow with view=workflow query=DRAFT and maxChars=40000. Keep the new receipt and all of its gaps; do not delete old context gaps or change source/cases/plugins. Import a MINIMAL TopicArtifact: one or two concise source-grounded claims, one cited Markdown line per claim. Omit modelInfo entirely because it is optional; use only the exact required Core fields. Use declared/static, original evidence IDs and unchanged sourceReferences from the new context. Then export-skill name=purchase-workflow and finish. Retain all cumulative model/tool/repair counts and the original durable deadline.
